resources.name: AirSensor
resources.description:
Read-only HTTP API of the AirSensor collector (air-raid alerts in Lviv oblast by raion).

The server listens on HTTP_PORT (default 8000). If you changed HTTP_PORT in .env, change `base_url` in the environment.

Times in query parameters are ISO 8601 dates or datetimes. Values without a time zone are Kyiv time, and a date-only `to` includes that whole day. Times in responses are shown in Kyiv time.

resources.name: Health
resources.description:
200 `ok` when the last read of the source was valid and the database answers.

503 `degraded` otherwise: `source.state` is `starting` (no valid read yet), `source_down` or `internet_down` (with the open outage), or `database` is `down`.

resources.name: Alerts
resources.description: GET /alerts: alert history, newest first. Every parameter is optional.

resources.name: Latest alerts
resources.description:
The 100 newest alerts. The disabled parameters show every filter; enable any of them.

- `raion`: one of the 7 raion names, e.g. `Стрийський район`
- `type`: `air-raid`, `artillery-shelling`, `urban-fights`, `chemical`, `nuclear`
- `from` / `to`: alerts active at any moment in this window
- `limit`: 1 to 1000 (default 100)

`start_uncertain` / `end_uncertain` mean the start or end fell inside an outage, so the time is when it was first or last observed.

resources.name: Alerts on a day
resources.description: Alerts active at any moment of `day` (Kyiv time, 00:00 to 24:00). Set `day` in the environment.

resources.name: Alerts in a time window
resources.description: Datetimes without an offset are Kyiv time. An explicit offset also works, e.g. `2026-11-19T06:00:00+00:00`.

resources.name: Alerts in one raion
resources.description: Raions: Львівський, Дрогобицький, Золочівський, Самбірський, Стрийський, Шептицький, Яворівський район. Any other value is a 400.

resources.name: Stats
resources.description: GET /stats: per raion, the alert count, total duration and longest alert. Only the part of each alert inside the window counts. All 7 raions are always listed.

resources.name: Stats, all time
resources.description: No window: everything stored, up to now.

resources.name: Stats for a day
resources.description: The alert part of the daily report for `day` (Kyiv time).

resources.name: Outages
resources.description: GET /outages: connection failures, newest first. `kind` is `source` (the site failed, internet up), `internet` (internet down) or `service` (AirSensor itself was not running). `reason` is the error kind that opened the outage.

resources.name: Latest outages
resources.description: The 100 newest outages. `ongoing: true` means it is still open; its `downtime_s` counts up to now.

resources.name: Outages on a day
resources.description: The outages behind the daily report for `day` (Kyiv time). The report sent on a given morning covers the previous day.

resources.name: Error examples
resources.description: Requests that are meant to fail, to show the error responses. A database failure on any endpoint gives 503 `{"error": "database_unavailable"}`.

resources.name: Unknown raion (400)
resources.description: Expected: 400, with the list of valid raion names in `detail`.

resources.name: Bad date (400)
resources.description: Expected: 400, `from must be an ISO 8601 date or datetime ...`.

resources.name: Limit out of range (422)
resources.description: Expected: 422, FastAPI's validation error (limit must be 1 to 1000).
